walk_forward: test year Y scored by models trained on labelled rows whose label window ends before Y's first session; window = sessions t+1..t+95 of the global calendar (session-counted labels, verified on the panel)

columns.fh95: anatomy: max high over the label window / entry close (ratio); window per label_basis in bakeoff.json
columns.label_span_sessions: FORWARD-LOOKING audit only: global-calendar sessions from t to the symbol's 95th next panel row (> 95 = the symbol misses sessions in the window); never a feature
columns.long_span: label_span_sessions >= 105 (row-counted labels: inflated; session-counted: lower bound)
columns.adv: 20d average traded value, Rs crore (from rows)
columns.core: anatomy's own flag (adjusted close > 50), kept for comparison only
columns.copied_session: trade_date is a copied non-trading session (panel row = an earlier session's bhavcopy); features are that earlier session's
columns.next_session_copied: the next calendar date of the panel is a copied session (label window repeats the high of t)
columns.high_over_close_t: adjusted high / close of the trade_date row (ratio)
columns.lgbm_rank: LambdaRank score: only its within-week order is meaningful
columns.ensemble: mean within-week percentile rank of lgbm, xgb, mlp (0-1)
columns.fold_train_end: last training trade_date of the fold that scored this row

units: scores are probabilities except lgbm_rank (unitless) and ensemble (percentile 0-1); ratios are fractions
